title: WIP Effects for the Next Shift
body:
After Plug & Prosper placed first overall in AI Browser Game Jam 4, I started working on its upcoming update. This work-in-progress motion atlas puts the new kiosk pieces side by side: a blinking Square Cell, a live shift clock, a turning gravity compass, a Shape Reader cycling through connector silhouettes, and an expanded customer cast.

The hardware uses the game's real Godot display paths. The portrait row is deliberately an effect study: the sleeping cat, golden retriever, grandma, and Steam Frog have working in-game effects, while the other sparkles, pulses, glints, halo, goggle blink, and ghost float are still capture-only concepts. The final update may use, change, or drop them.
